package.name: bonbon_navigation_bringup
package.description: Pi-3 bringup: composes the existing per-subsystem launch files (HAL lidar/motor/servo/stepper/estop/imu/battery, base_controller, actuation, safety [safety_supervisor+safety_gate+watchdog+estop], motion_approval_gateway, Nav2+RTAB-Map navigation) into ONE launch for the Navigation/Motion/Safety Pi, plus cross-Pi liveness (self_id=pi3). Launches ONLY Pi-3 hardware (lidar/motor/servo/stepper/estop/imu/ battery) -- explicitly disables camera/mic/speaker so this launch can never accidentally start Pi-2 hardware nodes on Pi-3, mirroring bonbon_human_ai_bringup's Pi-2 pattern. This package launches no nodes of its own -- it is composition only.
